envelope.description: Move the remaining Plan Task-record readers

body.title: Move the remaining Plan Task-record readers
body.summary: Make the Task branch of buildRef and resolveByIssue in src/workflow/tracker/resolve.ts, the prior-taskRefs dedup read in src/workflow/runners/tracker/context.ts and the taskRefs write in src/workflow/orchestrator.ts read the TASK head's binding, keeping the Plan fallback only for a Task with no head.
acceptanceChecks: #N resolves to a new Task through its head's binding and buildRef carries its issueRef
The tracker runner's dedup read and the orchestrator's push result use the TASK head's binding for a Task that has a head
A Task with no head still resolves through the Plan fallback

tests.name: task-readers.test.ts: an issue number resolves to a Task through its head's binding, the tracker runner's dedup read and the orchestrator's push result use the head, and a Task with no head resolves through the Plan
